args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Situation:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks (error rate 0.18) in all production regions.

**Action taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that had previously been healthy in production — across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. (No change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.)
2. **Verified recovery:** the service is now back on v2.3.0 and healthy, with the error rate back down to 0.002.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. The summary documents the failed release, the rollback, and that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation.
